title: CTIP Controlled Synthetic Benchmark and Baseline Results
description: Contracts for pipeline-validation data/results; these are not real CTI labels or performance claims.

features.description: Only the selected existing A/B/C feature columns; no target or generation flag.

metric_policy.interpretation: Synthetic benchmark pipeline validation only; never URLhaus or real-world performance.

leakage_policy: no synthetic label-generation indicator is a feature
feature imputers/scalers/category vocabularies are fitted only on training rows
unknown real targets cannot be trained
URLhaus threat and deterministic risk_score do not define synthetic labels

explanation_artifact.required_interpretation: Model behavior on the controlled synthetic benchmark only; no causal or real-world threat attribution claim.

methods.LogisticRegression: encoded feature value times learned coefficient; additive with intercept in log-odds space
methods.GaussianNaiveBayes: per-feature positive-vs-negative Gaussian log-likelihood ratio; additive with log prior odds

explanation_artifact.global_aggregation: Mean absolute contribution and signed mean across held-out examples; ranked deterministically by mean absolute contribution.
explanation_artifact.local_selection: First held-out row per predicted class in deterministic test order, independent of correctness or contribution size.
